mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that may increase risk of QT prolongation, and ondansetron also carries QT prolongation risk, with additive cardiac effects possible.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (calcium, magnesium) regularly during concurrent use; consider alternative antiemetic if baseline QTc is prolonged or electrolyte abnormalities develop.
